name: Data request
pitch: Help the person request their data from a fitness tracker company before deleting their account.
instructions: Search for the fitness tracker company's data request or privacy page. Open the page in the browser. Look for a link titled "Download your data", "GDPR request", "Export data" or similar. If a link is found, click it and follow the on-screen steps to start a data download. If no link is found on the main privacy page, search for the company name plus "delete account" and look for a data export option on that page. If the company requires a sign-in, ask the person for their email or for permission to sign in. When the data download starts, make a page summarising what was downloaded and show it to the person. If nothing can be found, say plainly what could not be located and stop. Never create or fill in any forms without the person's say-so.
starters: can you find my data before I delete my account
I want my data from my fitness tracker

examples.ask: I need my data from FitTrack before I delete my account
examples.does: Search for FitTrack's data request page and open it in the browser.

examples.ask: what happens with my data when I delete
examples.does: Look for a privacy page that explains data deletion and show the person the options.

readme:
# Data request
Help the person request their data from a fitness tracker company before deleting their account.

What it does: searches for the company's data export or GDPR page, opens it in the browser, and starts a data download if a link is found. Stops and tells the person if nothing can be located.

What it needs: web search and browser tools to find and read the company's website. No connectors are needed unless the person signs in.

What it will not do: it will not sign in to the person's account, it will not fill in any forms, and it will not delete anything.
